# Casey external temperature — fixed ground station

Outdoor air from the nearby official surface station. This is **not** balloon / x1 flight data and **not** the indoor X-Sense logger.

| Product | What it is |
|---------|------------|
| `layers/ground/casey/xsense/` | Internal building temperature average (X-Sense) |
| `layers/ground/casey/external/` | External / outdoor fixed ground station (KMTO / NWS) |
| `layers/ground/casey/daily/` + `casey-hourly.json` | Modelled outdoor series (Open-Meteo) |

Station: KMTO — Coles County Memorial Airport (Casey, IL).
